page.title: Organization users
page.description: Create accounts and set department, title, manager, and business permissions.

modal.deleteConfirm: Delete user "{{username}}"? This cannot be undone. {{count}} direct report(s) will have their manager cleared.
modal.resetPasswordConfirm: Reset password for "{{username}}" and force them to sign in again. Your session stays valid.

form.usernameHint: 3–32 characters; letters, digits, _ and - only; cannot start/end with _ or -. No Chinese. Example: emp01
form.usernameCharset: Username may only contain letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens (no Chinese)
form.usernameEdge: Username must not start or end with a hyphen or underscore
form.passwordHint: 8–128 characters; avoid common weak passwords (e.g. password, 12345678)
form.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters
form.passwordWeak: Password is too common; choose a stronger one
form.isAdminHint: Grants organization user management. Cannot demote the last admin or the system default account.

structure.title: Organization structure
structure.hint: The reporting tree is built from manager links; members without a manager appear in the "No manager" section below. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom. Edit managers on the Users tab.

alerts.adminOnly: Only system admins can manage organization users.

messages.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account
messages.cannotResetSelf: Use Change password for your own account
